data.narrative:
Frankenburg Technologies is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—operating in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and Anduril Industries.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the €40M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to the subsequent stage, implying a valuation of $80M. Peer-Median analysis examines four same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations of $4.0B (Stark Defence), $1.0B (Castelion), $400M (Singularity), and $125M (NODA AI), yielding a median of $700M and a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $68M (floor) to $805M (ceiling), with a median of $390M. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations—a 32x spread between minimum and maximum—and the stage-progression method's reliance on historical step-up conventions rather than company-specific fundamentals. The median implies Frankenburg positions between the lower and upper quartile of the peer set, consistent with a maturing Series A company without yet demonstrating the scale metrics of the highest-valued comparables.
